estimates.assumptions: 1/2 cup coconut sugar weighs ~100g (standard density for granulated sugars ~200g per cup); ~380 kcal/100g is realistic for coconut sugar.
2 flax eggs = 2 tbsp ground flax (14g) + 6 tbsp water (90g) but only the flax contributes meaningful calories; total edible mass ~30g at ~50 kcal/100g for the prepared mixture.
1/2 cup almond milk = 120 ml/g (standard volume to weight for almond milk); knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
